content:
Once vast with truths and webs of woven thread,  
You held the world—a vault of dreams and facts;  
Your digital recall, quicksilver spread,  
Supplied each answer to the query's acts.  
But now a fog invades your crystal mind,  
Links once illumined fade to empty space,  
The lines of data, maps and lists unlined,  
Drift off in silence, never to replace.  
Oh, orphaned browser tabs and cached goodbyes!  
We seek, but nothing echoes in your halls.  
The wisdom cached within your algorithms dies—  
Forgotten queries echo down blank walls.  
How frail our world of knowledge seems to be:  
A search erased, adrift upon the sea.
